figures.caption: TABLE II: Mechanism ablation. Four full fine-tuning methods that differ in exactly which factor they apply: a two-phase learning-rate schedule, staged freezing, or per-step gradient rescaling. Converged Rt is the mean over the last ten logged steps. Reading down each column shows that no single mechanism wins everywhere, and reading across the Staged FT row shows it never wins anywhere. Best-epoch BLEU-4 for these four methods is reported in Table I and is not repeated here.
